name: video-to-css
description: Turn any reference video into an editable strict HTML/CSS animation, with a timestamp-exact browser comparison harness.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium webkit
scripts.check:calibration: for e in tests/scenes/orbit-loop tests/scenes/dusk-hill tests/scenes/cube-3d; do node skills/video-to-css/scripts/v2css.mjs check $e || exit 1; done
